دُرَجَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ＝
-A2- Also, (ISk, S, K,) and ↓ دُرَّجَةٌ , (Sb, TA,) A certain bird, (ISk, S, K,) of which the inside of the wings is black, and the outside thereof dustcoloured; in form like the قَطَا, but smaller, or more slender: (ISk, S:) thought by IDrd to be the same as the دُرَّاج. (TA.) [See also دَرَّاجَةٌ, last sentence.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
